## TemplateEngine.\_isObjectLiteralBrace() method

Decides whether a `{` opens an object literal (keys are not scope reads) or a block.

**Signature:**

```typescript
static _isObjectLiteralBrace(tokens: Array<{
        type: string;
        value: string;
    }>, index: number): boolean;
```
